source_identity.title: The Effect of Amino Acids on Wound Healing: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis on Arginine and Glutamine

prior_artifact_search.result: No identity-matched ATOM, SEA, coverage, validation, reference, or processing artifact was found in the Clinical Medicine and Pharmacy GitHub Sync output folders before regeneration.

primary_result_conclusion.claim: Arginine hydroxyproline and multiple glutamine pooled outcomes were significant; the T-cell result was not significant.

numerical_claim.claim: Mortality OR 0.48, 95% CI 0.32 to 0.72, p=0.0004; 46/340 vs 89/356; I2=14%; paper reports NNT 10.

limitation_uncertainty.claim: Only five arginine studies, small samples, missing arginine outcomes, and high heterogeneity.

figure_table_claim.claim: SMD -0.16, 95% CI -0.33 to 0.01, totals 315 vs 312; Results prose reports 540 participants.

source_integrity_warnings.issue: Abstract hydroxyproline CI upper bound 4.45 conflicts with Results and Figure 8 upper bound 5.45.
source_integrity_warnings.resolution: Conflict preserved. The pooled-result atom and SEA synthesis use 5.45 because Figure 8 and Results agree.

source_integrity_warnings.issue: Methods and Figures 9 and 15 identify standardized mean difference, while surrounding prose or abstract call the effect MD.
source_integrity_warnings.resolution: Conflict preserved. Forest-plot effect measure SMD is used for those figure-derived pooled results.

source_integrity_warnings.issue: Figure 15 totals 315 experimental plus 312 control, 627 total, while Results prose says 540 participants.
source_integrity_warnings.resolution: Both are preserved. The Figure 15 atom uses the figure-derived totals.

source_integrity_warnings.issue: Abstract states ten electronic databases, while Methods explicitly names six search sources including Google Scholar grey literature.
source_integrity_warnings.resolution: Both statements are preserved. No unlisted databases were invented.

source_integrity_warnings.issue: Figures 4 and 5 contain selection counts that are not fully arithmetically reconcilable from the displayed nodes and category boxes.
source_integrity_warnings.resolution: Displayed counts are represented and the reconciliation problem is flagged.
